name: civil-engineering
description: Civil Engineering monorepo — web, mobile, backend

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix civil-web && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix civil-web && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.ci:local: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix civil-web
scripts.test:ci: npm run ci:local && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
